## 2. Overnight world read (verified outside the bus)
**HORMUZ — SEVEN-TANKER CLAIM DAY; largest single-day claim of the war.** Iran state TV / IRGC Navy claimed SEVEN vessels hit or mined near the strait on Oct-22 (Reuters, MarineLink, AP via TTNews) — if verified, the largest single-day vessel count since the war began Feb-28. A Kuwait-flagged tanker (KOTC context from last cycle) was struck by an unknown projectile in the strait; all 21 Indian crew safe (Swarajyamag). Newsquawk single-source: explosions in Sirik, claims of a US strike on an anti-ship missile launcher. Separately reported: US and Israel have developed plans for potential strikes on Iran AFTER the Nov-3 midterms (One Turn aggregate; Mitrade citing AP). Brent stood at $111.76 (+1.46%) at 09:15 UTC Oct-22 per straits.live; Nairametrics printed $111.60 (+2.59%); TTNews $111.19. PortWatch still 4 transits (Oct-18) vs 85/day baseline; AIS holding count DOWN to 105 vessels (from 149) — ships are leaving the watch box or going dark; Crisis Pressure extreme/flat, Escalation Forecast high/flat. No maritime authority has independently confirmed the seven-vessel claim beyond IRGC statements — claim logged, verification pending, NO incident numbers yet.

**OIL — leg day 12: settle holds, thin row jumps.** BZ=F: Oct-21 full row REVISED to O 109.27 / H 111.31 / L 107.69 / C 108.82 (vol 50,349) — settle holds the range; the thin-row forming 110.05 overshot the full settle again (thin = direction-only, fourth validation). Oct-22 thin row (vol 12): O 112.76 / H 112.98 / L 112.76 / forming 112.80 — +8.08 over the 104.72 firing settle, corroborated by independent press prints 111.2-113. Leg holding firmly; fails only on a settle below 104.72. CL=F: Oct-21 full C 97.15 (thin-vs-full divergence shrank to ~0.9%); Oct-22 thin forming 99.01, WTI press prints ~99. GC=F: Oct-21 full 4,150.00; Oct-22 forming 4,042.90 (-2.6%) — gold DOWN on a risk-off day: liquidation, not haven bid. Dup-volume artifact MIGRATED to Oct-20/21 pairs (BZ 50,349 / CL 382,038 / GC 161,101 both days) — eighteenth artifact cycle.

**RATES — THE RATES-STRESS LEG FAILS, ADJUDICATED THIS CYCLE.** ^TNX Oct-22 CLOSED 4.953 (from 5.146, -19.3bp), confirmed by Trading Economics 4.96-4.97. The pre-committed falsifier: leg fails if 10Y closes below 5.00% AND October odds hold under ~50%. 10Y 4.953 < 5.00 (met); Oct-28 hike odds ~6% < 50% (met). BOTH CONDITIONS MET — the rates-stress leg is DEAD as pre-committed, no discretion applied. The cushion read inverts: 5.00 is now overhead resistance, 4.7bp away.

**FED — October collapses to 6%; December relay drops 5.** DeFi Rate relay (observed Oct-22 6:33-7:01pm ET): Oct-28 hike ~6% two-venue (Kalshi 5.5 / Polymarket 5.5), hold 94%, cut ~2% (7-day: hike 29->6). December-9: relay 72% (-5pts d/d); Kalshi 7-day 76->72; Kalshi meeting-path Dec 77%. Kalshi internal gap CLOSED 0pt THIRD consecutive (decision 5.5 vs rate-level 5.5; sequence 1->2->0->0->0) — per the standing note, the oscillation model now yields to 'closed with noise reopenings.' 2026-hike venue gap WIDENED: Kalshi 78.5% vs Polymarket 72.5% (6pt, from 1pt). December spread vs CME-side prints (89.5 Reuters Oct-15 / 94 C-authority Oct-20 / ~83 stale Oct-10) WIDENS to ~17.5-22pt — fresh direct CME print still the owed adjudication. Blackout to Oct 27-28; September PCE Oct-29; midterms Nov-3 — 11 days. NOTE THE CROSS-ASSET CONTRADICTION: Brent >112 (inflationary supply shock, seven-tanker claim) while the entire rates complex EASES (10Y -19bp, Oct hike odds halved, Dec -5) — the market is pricing the AI-rout growth scare over the oil shock. That divergence cannot persist; one side reprices.

**CRYPTO — risk-off purge; SOL probes the falsifier zone and holds by 1.8 cents.** SOL: Oct-21 revised DOWN -0.55% to 106.7937 (from 107.3800p) — holds >105.84, contract stays broken. Oct-22 provisional: O 106.80 / H 107.34 / L 103.0177 / C 103.25 (-3.31%) — the no-probe streak ends at three; first probe of the $103 handle since Oct-18, bottoming 1.77 cents ABOVE the $103.00 hard falsifier. LEDGER NOTE: earlier MTD prints (-98.3, -64.8) carried unrevised rows; the table has since revised — logged as a bookkeeping correction, not a signal. Flow->price note: record two-day inflow (+526.7/+23.2 then +524.8) preceded... the Oct-22 purge — the lead relationship BREAKS on the third datapoint (inflow did NOT lead price this time; the AI rout overrode). Tagged for the eval set as a counterexample.

**RIYADH — decision passed, outcome not yet visible.** Najran (A3627/26) and Jizan (A3626/26) NOTAMs expired 18:00 AST Oct-22; Abha nightly notice ended 06:00 Oct-22. No post-decision update in any tracked source this cycle — extend-or-reopen UNCONFIRMED, carried to next cycle. First post-reopening Houthi claim still absent (+122h); Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia continued per aggregate reporting, but none claimed at RUH. Carrier markers Oct-24 (Etihad/QR) land next cycle.

**ALPENGLOW — day two.** No independent post-switch finality measurement published beyond day-one ~6.6s converging; SolanaCompass confirms handoff at slot 459,653,000, 13:54 UTC. Re-base at epoch 1064 stands; vote-tx-free TPS series remain the only valid activity reads. Rotor unscheduled; Firedancer bounty 2x/3x to Nov-20.

**Data-path check:** Binance 35th check — PARTIAL, first non-failure after four consecutive full disconnects: BTCUSDT and SOLUSDT returned live 24h data (BTC 81,361.87 -3.64% / SOL 103.37 -3.74%); ETHUSDT returned HTTP 451. (2) **SOL'S 1.77-CENT SURVIVorship IS NOT A SIGNAL** — the probe (103.0177) and provisional close (103.25) sit inside revision noise of the falsifier; tonight's revision is the adjudicator, not the wick. If the revised close prints <103.00 the crypto trigger fails for SOL; if not, the defense read extends to a fourth data point at a LOWER level — the $103 line is now being tested, not just held above. Markets are pricing growth destruction (AI capex/borrowing scare) as the dominant force over energy inflation. One side must reprice; if oil holds >110 into PCE (Oct-29), the rates complex is the side that moves. Watching, no position. (4) **FLOW->PRICE LEAD TAKES ITS FIRST COUNTEREXAMPLE** — +524.8M completion followed by a -3.3% session. The two-point 'lead' is now 2-for-3; eval set updated, no regression claim. (5) **KALSHI GAP: MODEL SWITCH EXECUTED** — third consecutive 0pt; 'closed with noise reopenings' replaces the oscillation model. (6) **DECEMBER: SPREAD WIDENS THE WRONG WAY FOR CME-SIDE** — relay 72 vs CME-side 89.5/94: the 17.5-22pt spread with a STALE CME authority is now the widest on record for this board; a fresh direct CME print remains the only admissible adjudicator. (7) **HORMUZ: CLAIM vs CONFIRMATION** — seven vessels claimed, zero incident numbers; AIS holding count fell 149->105 (dark or departed); the throughput five-way persists. Escalation Forecast high/flat while the Escalation FACT count jumps — index lag logged.
- External calibration: SOL revised 106.7937 vs 107.3800p (-0.55%); BTC revised 84,011.97 vs 84,394.78p (-0.45%); ETH revised 2,470.77 vs 2,483.16p (-0.50%). Revision direction ALL DOWN this cycle — first uniform revision day since the streak; one day is not a pattern, flagged. DeFi Rate observation window Oct-22 6:33-7:01pm ET — fresh. Binance partial cross-check agrees.
